svg.title: Paired d of TRACE v5.1 versus the best rival, four gate cells
svg.desc: One point per already-committed gate replication. Solid red line at 0 (the BEST bar). Dashed green line at the published mean d from V5_1_GATE_RESULTS.md. Drawn from v5_1_gate_shape.jsonl; no new fit.
svg.text: Paired d = err(v5.1) − err(best rival), graded channel
mean d = -0.01475 upper t = -0.01206 upper boot = -0.01218 δ = 0.004025 BEST
Solid red line: 0, the BEST bar (one-sided 95% upper bound of the mean must be below 0). Dashed green line: published mean d.
Points: committed replications in v5_1_gate_shape.jsonl, scored with the same graded_err as summarize_v5_1_gate.py. Numbers quoted from V5_1_GATE_RESULTS.md. No new run.
